guideSecGettingStartedContent.message: Click the Source Download tab in the DevTools toolbar (press F12 / Ctrl+Shift+I, then the tab in the DevTools toolbar). Chrome does not allow extensions to open DevTools automatically, which is why the panel lives there. The toolbar icon popup lets you choose which categories feed the badge counter on the icon. The sun/moon button in the panel toolbar locks a light or dark theme independently of Chrome; that choice is remembered.

guideSecCategoriesContent.message: The vertical tabs on the left sort every captured resource into 15 categories, such as images, videos, fonts, source maps and API calls, plus a Text & Tables tab. Each tab shows a live count. Only one category is shown at a time; switching resets all filters, so what you see always matches the tab.

guideSecSearchFiltersContent.message: The search bar filters by name, URL, type, alt text or title. Enclose your query in /…/ to use a regular expression, e.g. /\.(png|jpg)$/. Below the toolbar, the filter bar changes per category: size and dimension ranges for media, HTTP method and request type for APIs, plus sorting and direction.

guideSecGridViewContent.message: Toggle between a compact grid (small thumbnails) and a detailed list with the buttons next to the search bar. Your choice is remembered between sessions. In list view, checkboxes let you select individual resources for a bulk download.

guideSecInspectContent.message: Click any resource to open it in the inspect pane on the right. Each opened file becomes a tab, so you can compare several resources side by side — the newest opens on the left. Specialized viewers exist for images, video, audio, fonts, SVG, and text/code (with a Beautify toggle). APIs show a split view: response on the left, request details (method, status, headers, query parameters and body) on the right.

guideSecDownloadingContent.message: Download Visible saves the currently visible resources (active category + search + filters) as a ZIP; it relabels to Download Filtered (N) when filters are active. Hover any download button to see an estimated archive size before you click. Download Selected downloads only the checked items. Download All captures every discovered resource into a folder-structured ZIP. Failed downloads are marked, and you can retry them with one click from the notification, the item's warning icon or the context menu. Export writes the visible list as JSON or CSV, or dumps Chrome's network log as a HAR file.

guideSecLightboxContent.message: The zoom button opens media in a full-size lightbox where you can pan by dragging, zoom with the mouse wheel, the on-screen buttons or the keyboard (<kbd>+</kbd>/<kbd>-</kbd> to zoom, <kbd>0</kbd> to reset, <kbd>Esc</kbd> to close).

guideSecTextTablesContent.message:
The Text category is a live, readable copy of the page: headings, paragraphs, lists and links in page order, refreshed while Live is on. Hover any line to copy it, or use Copy text, Markdown and TXT for everything shown.

Switch to Tables to see each table on the page as a card with a preview and its own Excel, CSV and Copy buttons; All tables to Excel puts every table in one workbook, one sheet each. Tables that change keep a history of snapshots, and Show all rows merges them into one deduplicated table — exactly what an export contains.

The boxes on the left sort the page by element type — all page text, each heading level, paragraphs, links, list items, buttons, code and more — with a count and a first line for each; pick one to see only those, and copy or export just that. The search box filters as you type, and the menu beside it switches it to a regular expression, a CSS selector or an XPath expression (also value expressions such as count(//a) or //@href) run against the live page; the Custom query box does the same. Whatever the page says about a broken query is shown inside the box.

guideSecCaptionsContent.message: WebVTT, SRT, TTML and other caption files — including <track> sources — land in their own Captions tab instead of mixing with documents.

guideSecSourceMapsContent.message: .map files and JSON bodies that look like source maps (they contain mappings and sources) are grouped under Source maps, with the JSON viewer and Beautify, so they no longer clutter the JSON tab.

guideSecDupesContent.message: On the Images tab the panel hashes captured bytes and marks identical files. A Hide duplicates filter keeps the first copy of each set so a ZIP of the view does not ship the same thumbnail twice.

guideSecVideoHlsContent.message: Streams the browser cannot play natively (HLS .m3u8, DASH .mpd, unknown codecs) show a fallback instead of a black player. For HLS you can merge the segments into a single video file right from the panel, or download the original manifest.

guideSecPowerTipsContent.message: Dynamic API responses (XHR/fetch) are not deduplicated by URL — each reply stays in the list (capped FIFO) so you can compare repeated requests. Static assets are deduplicated. Use Refresh to re-scan the current DOM, and reload the page while the panel is open to capture every network request, including ones triggered before you switched tabs.
